description: This Dart file defines a Flutter screen widget 'NurseJobSearchScreen' that provides a user interface for nurses to search for nearby job opportunities. It includes functionality to request location permission, obtain current location, update map markers, and display a list of job postings fetched from a provider.

classes.name: NurseJobSearchScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a map and list of nurse jobs around the current location with search radius control.

classes.name: _NurseJobSearchScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the map, location permissions, job data loading, and UI updates.

methods.name: _locateAndLoad
methods.description: Requests location permission, fetches current position, updates map marker, and triggers job load for current location.
